why: Re-check of the 125 US private-gap parks (ids.json) whose inclusion_evidence carried no rate read on their own site: admitted 2026-10-01..07 on RV Life's tier, a Google listing or an unread operator page. The same screen in Canada let through closed, seasonal-only and tent-only parks. Each park's own pages were read (scan.py, then the one-browser driver for pages plain urllib could not load); no-website parks were checked against their Google listing, review recency included.
